items.title: Williams Companies (WMB) Completes Key Gas Deal And Deepens Haynesville Reach
items.summary: Williams Companies (NYSE:WMB) has completed its acquisition of Momentum Midstream, expanding its natural gas footprint in the Haynesville region. The enlarged pipeline network is structured to feed growing LNG, industrial and power sector demand tied to Haynesville supply. Management positions the combined infrastructure as a key piece of Williams Companies' natural gas platform through at least 2030.
